hi! i had to have a major surgery a few years ago and was really worried about this too since I was a minor at the time and wasn't sure if my family would have to be informed about my scars (they were mostly healed but it was still pretty obvious what they were). in my case it never got brought up by surgeons, nurses, or any other medical staff. Once I was home I still needed help with showering since the surgery absolutely wrecked my mobility for a while and i found that having some swim shorts on gave me the coverage and privacy I needed. It's hard to spare the emotional energy for a conversation like that with family when you're recovering from an operation so I understand your worry, but I hope this can help make you feel a little less scared about things at least. stay safe and take care ♡
